normalizedResponse.intent: gas-timed execution of 15 transactions at Low scenario
normalizedResponse.reasoning: Low scenario at 18 gwei with 100% fill is the only viable option since all 15 transactions must execute. USD cost = 15 txs × 250,000 gas × 18 gwei × 1e-9 ETH/gwei × $3,200/ETH = 15 × 250,000 × 18 × 1e-9 × 3,200 = 0.0675 ETH × $3,200 = $216. Medium (48 gwei, 70% fill) and High (92 gwei, partial unfilled) are infeasible as they cannot guarantee all 15 transactions execute.
